items.title: Skitch Henderson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Milford, Connecticut, October 31, 1998
items.q: Yeah, that’s Doc and Clark and Snooky... Clark and Snooky were the greatest disciples that ever came along... they played... they were together

ctx.x: I wanted to show you a photo here that Bob Rosengarden gave us. It’s got quite a decent trumpet section there.
Yeah, that’s Doc and Clark and Snooky, yeah, Bob and—
Marian McPartland there. The bari player?
